title: Two or more external windows freeze game under Wayland+NVIDIA+Vulkan combo
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.3-stable - Reproducible in: 4.4.1-stable - Reproducible in: 4.5.1-stable - Reproducible in: master 9cd297b6f2a0ee660b8f1a6b385582cccf3a9d10 ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sun, 19 Oct 2025 19:21:18 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU - AMD Ryzen 7 7435HS (16 threads) - 15.30 GiB memory ### Issue description Once two or more external (i.e. not embedded) windows are opened, about 7 seconds later all open external windows as well as the game window freeze. I can reproduce this with any mix of Window and FileDialog nodes. This does not reproduce if only one external window is open. The issue occurs both inside the editor as well as in an exported project. Crucially, it does not matter whether the editor itself is using the X11 or Wayland display servers, and it does not matter what display server the game is using. As long as Godot is running under a Wayland compositor, the issue exists. As a side note, I originally noticed this in the texture packer dialog of Terrain3D (a C++ GDExtension). In that case, the editor froze as well (presumably because it is the "game window" in this case). The profiler stops once this happens, consistently at around 6.7 seconds: I can reproduce in both native Wayland mode as well as through XWayland. I'm using KWin 6.5.0 as my Wayland compositor, and I've been able to reproduce on KWin 6.4.5. Confirmed to **not** be reproducible in an X11 session (LXDE, lxdm 0.5.3). Confirmed to be reproducible under Hyprland 0.51.1, although the timing is different (around 17s). Confirmed to be reproducible under GNOME on Wayland (gnome-shell 49.1) with a timing of about 18-19s until freeze. Consolidated key information from comments: * This is a regression brought by NVIDIA drivers version 580.95.05. A notable change in this version is the introduction of support for `fifo-v1`, but the issue reproduces on both Hyprland (which currently does not support `fifo-v1`) and a custom build of KWin with `fifo-v1` support removed completely + a custom build of Godot that with `fifo-v1` support removed completely as well. * The issue does not reproduce on the previous version of the NVIDIA drivers (575.64.05). * It still reproduces on 580.105.08. responding ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Running the default scene will open two Window nodes on top of each other, each one with two buttons without text. The game window will also have two buttons. While the buttons initially react to hover and click events, after a couple of seconds they stop completely.
